overview: Mozambique is a country in south-eastern Africa, on the Indian Ocean. Its capital and largest city is Maputo. Mozambique became independent from Portugal in 1975, and Portuguese is the official language. It is the only country with a modern rifle, an AK-47, on its national flag.

geography.text: Mozambique has a very long coastline on the Indian Ocean, with beaches, coral reefs and islands such as the Bazaruto Archipelago. Low plains cover the south and the coast, rising to plateaus and mountains in the north-west. The Zambezi river crosses the country, and the Cahora Bassa dam on it has created one of Africa's largest artificial lakes.

history.text: Swahili trading towns grew up along the coast, and inland the Mutapa kingdom traded gold. Portugal ruled Mozambique for centuries. After a ten-year war of independence led by FRELIMO, Mozambique became independent in 1975. A civil war followed until 1992.

events.title: Vasco da Gama
events.text: The Portuguese explorer reaches Mozambique Island.

events.title: Independence
events.text: Mozambique becomes independent under Samora Machel.

events.title: Peace
events.text: A peace agreement ends the civil war.

government.text: Mozambique is a presidential republic. The FRELIMO party has governed since independence in 1975. Disputed elections in 2024 led to deadly protests. An insurgency in the northern province of Cabo Delgado has displaced many people.

economy.text: Mozambique exports aluminium, coal, natural gas and electricity. Huge offshore gas fields could transform its economy. Most people are farmers, and it is one of the poorest countries in the world.

culture.text: Mozambique has a long Indian Ocean coastline and Swahili, Arab and Portuguese influences. Marrabenta music began in Maputo. Mozambique Island, the old colonial capital, is a UNESCO site. Timbila, xylophone orchestras of the Chopi people, are listed by UNESCO.

sport.text: Football is the most popular sport, and Mozambique-born Eusébio starred for Portugal and Benfica. Maria Mutola won the 800 m at the 2000 Olympics, Mozambique's only gold.

items.title: Eusébio
items.text: Born in Maputo; the 1966 World Cup top scorer.

didYouKnow: Mozambique's flag is the only national flag with a modern rifle on it.
Mozambique has more than 2,400 km of Indian Ocean coastline.
